# Observer API

> The API reference of `@playcanvas/observer` {{VERSION}}: observable data (`Observer` and `ObserverList`), events and undo history, which PCUI components bind to.

For guides, see Data Binding in the [PCUI index](https://developer.playcanvas.com/user-manual/pcui/llms.txt) of the User Manual.
